metadata.title: TVDE Hub Portugal — Drivers, fleets and customers
metadata.description: The marketplace connecting TVDE drivers, fleet operators and customers across Portugal.

hero.title: The trusted meeting point for drivers, fleets and customers
hero.subtitle: Find verified TVDE drivers and fleets, grow your operation, or request a ride for your guests. Simple, transparent and in your language.

driver.title: I'm a driver
driver.description: Publish your profile, find a fleet and receive invitations.

fleet.title: I'm a fleet owner
fleet.description: Showcase your fleet, find drivers and receive customer requests.

customer.title: I need a driver
customer.description: Browse verified drivers and fleets, or post one request. No account needed.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three simple steps, whoever you are.

driver.title: Drivers
driver.step1: Create your profile and upload your documents.
driver.step2: Get verified and appear in search.
driver.step3: Apply to fleets or accept invitations.

fleet.title: Fleet owners
fleet.step1: Publish your fleet and operator licence.
fleet.step3: Answer customer requests and assign drivers.

customer.title: Customers
customer.step1: Browse profiles or fill in one request.
customer.step2: Receive replies and quotes by email.
customer.step3: Follow your booking and leave a review.

footer.tagline: A directory and connection service for TVDE in Portugal.
footer.rights: © {year} TVDE Hub Portugal. All rights reserved.

legal.notice: TVDE Hub Portugal is a directory and connection service. It is not a transport operator. All users must comply with Portuguese TVDE regulations (Lei n.º 45/2018 and applicable IMT rules).

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to manage your profile, documents and requests.
auth.registerSubtitle: Free for drivers and fleet owners. It takes about a minute.
auth.name: Full name or company name

auth.googleOnboardingNote: With Google you'll choose driver or fleet owner in the next step.
auth.roleDriverDescription: I drive TVDE and want to find fleets and work.
auth.roleFleetDescription: I operate vehicles and want drivers and customers.

auth.onboardingSubtitle: Tell us how you will use TVDE Hub so we can set up your profile.

overview.subtitleDriver: Complete your profile and documents to get verified and found by fleets and customers.
overview.subtitleFleet: Complete your company profile and documents to get verified and found by drivers and customers.
overview.completenessDescription: A complete profile gets noticed more often.
overview.allDone: Your profile is complete. Great work!
overview.verificationDescription: The Verified badge appears after our team approves all of these documents.

visibility.title: Public visibility
visibility.descriptionDriver: Choose whether customers and fleets can find your profile.
visibility.descriptionFleet: Choose whether customers and drivers can find your fleet.
visibility.publicHint: Your profile appears in search results.
visibility.hiddenHint: Only you can see your profile.

items.bio: Write a short bio (at least 40 characters)

profile.driverSubtitle: This is what customers and fleets see. Your email and phone are never shown publicly.
profile.fleetSubtitle: This is what customers and drivers see. Contact details stay private until you reply or accept.
profile.phoneHint: Private. Shared only after a connection is accepted.
profile.languagesHint: Customers filter by language, so add them all.
profile.serviceAreasHint: Select every district or island where you work.

sections.locationDescription: Where you are based and where you can work.
sections.companyDescription: Logo, name and description of your fleet.
sections.privateDescription: Never shown publicly. Used for verification and shared only after a connection is accepted.
sections.offerDescription: Services, languages and terms for drivers.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitleDriver: Upload your documents so our team can verify you.
documents.subtitleFleet: Upload your company documents so our team can verify you.
documents.privacyBody: Only you and our verification team can open them. They are never shown on your public profile, and every admin view is logged.
documents.listDescription: Status updates appear here and you will be notified by email.
documents.emptyDescription: Upload your documents below to start verification.
documents.confirmDeleteApproved: This document is approved. Deleting it removes your Verified badge. Continue?
